title: The assigned-user count is correct when a delete is blocked
custom_preconds: 1. A custom role is assigned to exactly one user.
custom_steps:
1. Reach the delete-blocked state for that role.
  2. Read the user count shown.
custom_expected: The count shown is 1, matching the one assigned user.
evidence: UI: Parth Cust1 Users column shows 1; its menu has no Delete — the assigned-user count matches the blocked-delete state.
